notes.title: Ending Tau in 2025: Check out our big news!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! 

It's been a while since we last updated you in here, but that's for a good cause: we're alive, well, and been working nonstop on Ending Tau. Early next year, you'll finally be able to see all of it yourself.

There's been a lot of developing in the last months, and we'd like to share a few highlights with you.

[h3]1. Meta-progression is finally here[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658232/3d78590f0cc72e73bfc14a3a408b6c036dce47cf.gif[/img]
Rebuilding your village will not only help your people, but also your own journey. Using memory shards, you can grow stronger and go farther inside the jungle than ever. The painter will grant you some of these perks.

[h3]2. Massive boss fights are ready[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658232/4efe113292d69f25fad666ad38947d82f4558280.gif[/img]
We want to keep this spoiler-light, so we'll tell you this: we're two bosses away from the final version of the game. You can now face 5 unique Godfiends and the one above is the Godfiend of the Wetlands. You will learn more about him soon.

[h3]3. Introducing the Eel curses[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658232/e4c361d811dfcad7ac6334ec7c033079ac69ab13.gif[/img]
A new animal curse enters jungle. And with it, hundreds of new builds are now possible. 

[h3]4. Meet the third biome[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658232/9f5c624a375c652affe82b025202590dd0d13683.gif[/img]

The Field is a dry land that once had a lush environment with this world's biggest fauna. Now, you will stumble across mud creatures, termites nests, and cursed trees. But keep your eyes open: some beautiful entities survived the curse of Tau there and might be helpful in your journey.

[h3]5. EA is around the corner[/h3]
We were planning on an EA release at the end of this year. But due to some publishing decisions, we felt it'd be for the best to hold for a few more months. We're insanely excited to share everything with you. We can't wait. But we shall, just a little bit more!

We truly appreciate your support and patience. The full release is taking a while, but we really want to make sure everything is up to the standards you and Ending Tau deserves. We're too obsessive to do this in any other way. But we're getting there! Stay tuned.

How are you feeling about Ending Tau? We'd love to hear your thoughts.

notes.title: What's next for Ending Tau?
notes.content:
2023 brought us awesome experiences and we're thrilled to have all of you by our side on our journey. But with our current demo on a stable state and 2024 around the corner, one question arises: what's next for Ending Tau? Let's talk about it.

[h3]New year, same goal[/h3]

It's time to get back under our rocks for a minute. Our first public demo gave us amazing insights and we're taking them to heart. Now, we're rolling up our sleeves and adding new content in the game with eyes on the bigger picture. 

[h3]All eyes on the prize[/h3]

This means we'll be a little less active on social media, but don't worry: if you don't hear a lot from us, it just means we're putting all our energy into the best possible game we can make. We're a very small team and our priority has always been very clear. We won't let you down!

[h3]Second biome on the way[/h3]

In case you're wondering: right now, we're working on the game's second biome (The Swamp) alongside the many new progression mechanics you'll see in the full release (including a new animal curse). The foundations of the game are already outlined, so you can expect a more steep progression curve from here on. Here's a tiny spoiler: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658232/962c082a6caf7f8ed342f25678edf0418852edaa.png[/img]

[h3]Early access release[/h3]

We're aiming at an early access release in the first semester of 2024. The full extent of our first EA release is not entirely set yet. But we guarantee one thing: we're not putting anything half baked into the world. That means we might take some extra time to finesse all the mechanics of the game, but know that EA will be as close as possible to the game's 1.0 release. Our main goal with EA is to be able to digest the community's feedback and have the game grow towards the right direction before a final version. To us, it's not a crutch, it's a very important tool to improve and reassess our assumptions. 

[h3]New badass promo art[/h3]

Bonus news: it came to our attention that our previous promo art kinda... sucked. Though we personally loved it, it was pretty dark for a promo art. Streamers were struggling to make thumbnails with it, people were having a hard time to spot us on the Steam store, etc. So with the massive talent from Vitor (@Ahighmentality), we now have this new promo capsule! Let us know what you think :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658232/9f5ec4f54e416caa46cb4c860b5df465e59e47a2.jpg[/img]

After a very important break this end of the year, we're ready to move all speed ahead in January. Stick around. We'll be back soon. 

Happy holidays, everyone :)

With love,
Rafa, Andre, Felipe, Henrique, Vitor, and Maria.

notes.title: Update 0.5.1: No Place for Vampires
notes.content:
In this patch, you can expect graphic improvements, overall balancing, some very meaningful bug fixes, and most importantly... more juice (including extra blood). Speaking of blood: every entity in the game now casts a shadow. Which leaves no doubt that there are NO vampires in our game, in case someone was wondering.

[b][h3]COMBAT UPDATES:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] "The Capelobo" is now harder to beat. Check it out.
[*] [b]"The Capelobo" elite[/b] version implemented in [b]Chaos Mode.[/b]
[*] Heavily improved [b]Capelobo Cub's [/b]animation
[*] [b]Relic synergy[/b] improved 
[/list]

[b][h3]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies now [b]draw more blood[/b]. 
[*] All entities now [b]cast shadows[/b].
[/list]

[b][h3]OVERALL IMPROVEMENTS:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed all reported game breaking bugs.
[*] New loading tips
[*] Dialogue and localization improvements
[*] Audio mixing enhancements
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.5.0: Minibosses, Chaos Mode, and More
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest is here! And to celebrate, we're releasing a huge demo update.

Minibosses, new challenges, and for those who thought the first biome was too easy... chaos mode. Time to show us how slick y'all are.

[h3][b]CHAOS MODE:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now unlock [b]The Statue[/b] in the Jungle by completing the demo (or finding it in the jungle).
[*] When you return to The Village, [b]The Statue[/b] will be waiting for you.
[*] Giving it an offering will trigger [b]Chaos Mode[/b].
[*] In Chaos Mode, every enemy is an [b]Elite enemy[/b].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658232/2bd77bd7b0a632fb7877cdf4af25d9322ba139bc.gif[/img]

[h3][b]NEW ENEMIES:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Miniboss: you can now face the mighty leader [b]leader of the Capelobos[/b].
[*] [b]Elite Centipede[/b] implemented.
[*] [b]Elite Capelobo Cub[/b] implemented.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658232/f27aab97b90e7b7cf4fa7f2b7600b667ece84abc.gif[/img]

[h3][b]COMBAT UPDATES:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Spell rebalancing.
[*] Elite enemy graphics rework.
[*] Hit impact improvements.
[*] Enemies no longer damage you right after spawning.
[*] Player and projectiles now have silhouettes when behind objects.
[/list]
[h3][b]GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Further FX and accessibility improvements.
[*] Collider/Warp bug fixes.
[*] Localization fixes.
[*] Sound mixing improvements.
[/list]
And there's a lot more on the way. Like in some successful roguelike experiences, our main goal with the upcoming patches is to improve everything about the game with [b]your[/b] help. This is a work-in-progress and an obsessive search for balance. We'll be here to hear your feedback. Stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: Update 0.4.2: The Big Combat Revamp
notes.content:
The first demo week was amazing and with it came a lot of learnings. We spent the whole week balancing and tweaking mechanics while absorbing everyone's feedbacks. Shout out to @Retromation, @Haelian, and many others for their very insightful videos! And thanks to all of you who have been trying out our game.

In this new version, you can expect drastic combat tweaks for a more dynamic gameplay. You will also find accessibility improvements, and overall bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658232/9e6e8ba0072748b5a97960cf9a9ad05d07694831.gif[/img]

[h3][b]COMBAT IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Enhanced controllability of [b]all attacks[/b]
[*] [b]Armadillo Body[/b] controllability heavily enhanced
[*] [b]Wolf Arms attack[/b] speed and range increased
[*] [b]Dashes/Attacks[/b] are now comboable (each body has its own combo window to be mastered)
[*] With some arm curses, you can now connect [b]Strong Attacks[/b] to[b] Quick Attacks[/b].
[*] [b]Next dash inputs[/b] are now stored for seamless combos
[*] [b]Curse buffs from relics[/b] are now displayed on inventory
[/list]

[h3][b]ACCESSIBILITY IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]VFXs[/b] updates
[*] [b]"Flashing lights" options[/b] are now available
[*] Scene lighting improvements
[*] Scenic transition improvements
[*] Audio mixing improvements
[/list]

[h3][b]ENEMY IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Overall smarter enemies
[*] Amarilis Ultra implemented! ([i]the elite version of the flower shooter pal[/i]) 
[*] Capelobo Minion ([i]the big anteater guy[/i]) HP and range increased
[*] Centipede pathfinder improvements
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
[u][b]Leave us your impressions[/b][/u]. Like in some successful roguelike experiences, our main goal with the upcoming patches is to improve our gameplay with your help. Know this is a work-in-progress and an obsessive search for balance. We'll be here to hear your feedback!

Thanks for being around at such an early moment of our journey. Stay tuned for the next update!
